findings.note: SB 1 (2021 second called session), election integrity law that, among other things, sets ID-number rules for mail ballots. The Texas Legislature Online page lists this member among the House cosponsors; last action on the page is 09/07/2021.

SB 16 (2025), requires proof of citizenship to register to vote, with a limited federal ballot for those who cannot supply it. The Texas Legislature Online page lists this member among the House cosponsors; page shows House committee report sent to Calendars 05/25/2025.

HB 1478 (2025), by another member, on the failure of a voter registrar to comply with voter registration laws. The page lists her among the coauthors; last action 04/22/2025, committee report sent to Calendars.
